notes.title: Fofumia Demo
notes.content:
[p]Hello everybody,[/p][p][/p][p]We are very happy to be part of the Steam Next Fest that is happening this week with our newest project: Fofumia. Come check it out and give the demo a try!![/p][p][/p][p]Since the game is still in active development we would love to know what you think of this demo. Your input can help us turn Fofumia into your favorite game![/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to drop your thoughts in the comments down below.[/p][p][/p][p]Have Fun :)[/p][p]Actoon Team[/p][p]
[/p]
